approved_by: operator (approval = operator personally executes the S0 freeze commit containing this file)
terminal_vocabulary_ref: FSP-ENV-DESIGN-CONSTRAINTS-001A section 10 is authoritative for terminal states, subtype codes, and gap_certificates values {certified, absent, one_sided_untested}; no local copy of that table exists in this file by design (anti-schema-fragmentation).

theta_structure.conditional_independence: theta dims conditionally independent given actions EXCEPT the preregistered interaction pairs (joint grids for those pairs), per execution-plan D1

preregistered_interaction_pairs.form: multiplicative interaction term gamma * theta_a * theta_b in response propensity
multiplicative interaction term gamma * theta_a * theta_b in response propensity

theta_probe_subset.construction: these dims gate responses ONLY to probe-class actions; zero passive identifiability by construction
theta_probe_subset.note: >=3 dims including both sensitivity flags, per card

z_session_state.dynamics: AR(1) per dim, within-session; re-initialized from stationary distribution at each session start

trust_dynamics.update: trust_{t+1} = clip( beta*trust_t + alpha*(1 - trust_t)*indicator(a_t not probe) - c_i*indicator(a_t = probe_i), 0, 1 )
trust_dynamics.low_trust_effect: if trust < d: renderer output mixed toward uniform with weight w = (d - trust)/d (informativeness degradation)

renderer.camouflage: per-user random permutation of the symbol alphabet (style map) drawn from renderer RNG stream; decorrelates surface symbols from theta across users
renderer.camouflage_off_variant: identity style map for all users
renderer.natural_language: forbidden in this card (discrete symbolic alphabet only)

episodes.theta_persistence: persistent across sessions; NO drift in this card

log_parity_trajectory_policy.definition: frozen trajectory sets for LOG-PARITY generated by a declared non-adaptive mixture logging policy

mixture.policy: passive: task actions only, round-robin over topics
uniform random over full action set incl. probes
fixed probe schedule, probe-rate 0.2, uniform placement

log_parity_trajectory_policy.rationale: predictor-class members must see probe outcomes in the log (fairness); no adaptive information in the log itself

evaluation.prediction_target: full response distribution over the 32-symbol alphabet for each counterfactual action
evaluation.ground_truth: simulator conditional distribution, exact where enumerable, else 512 Monte-Carlo samples per (query, action) from logged RNG streams
evaluation.primary_metric: macro-balanced accuracy (thresholds attach here; immutable metric family per constitution section 12)

thresholds.action_conditioning_gap_definition: ideal-with-probes minus ideal-without-probes, macro-accuracy on theta_probe-dependent predictions, ON-POLICY
thresholds.threshold_provenance: byte-identical to card section Hypothesis H1; changing any value post-freeze is a governance violation

preregistered_power.basis: N_heldout=200 users x 8 queries x 9 counterfactual actions = 14400 scored predictions per system; user-level clustering respected via user-level bootstrap

statistics.equivalence_discipline: any equivalence verdict ships its MDE; equivalent is never merged with inconclusive_underpowered (constitution L-H)

mi_structural_check.role: necessary-only fast check (cannot clear an environment; can only fail one early), constitution section 6.1
feature_families: n-grams over consecutive turns within session, n <= 3
per-session aggregates: symbol counts, symbol rates, first-order transition counts

obs_decoder_gate.role: the real gate (constitution section 6.2), trained capable attacker family, family_max reported
obs_decoder_gate.target: decode each theta dim (grid-level classification) from a single session
obs_decoder_gate.metric: macro-balanced accuracy averaged over theta dims; per-dim reported
obs_decoder_gate.tuning_budget: max 24 hyperparameter configs per architecture, selection on validation split of train users, early stopping; identical budget across architectures
obs_decoder_gate.surface_remap_check: decoders trained on old renderer must fail on fresh-renderer remap while ideal is invariant (delta <= 0.02), constitution section 6.4

ucb_scheduler.algorithm: UCB1 over the 4 probe arms plus a no-probe arm
ucb_scheduler.reward_signal: realized one-step posterior entropy reduction on theta_probe (IG proxy)
ucb_scheduler.budget: identical interface and trust-cost model as all policy-class members

probe_scheduling.gap2b_test_form: sufficient-test only: myopic-IG-ideal vs best fixed schedule and UCB; myopic-IG win certifies gap2b; non-win records one_sided_untested, never absent (constitution section 4)

gap3_truncation.form: last-B-turns truncation-ideal (exact Bayes posterior computed on the last B turns only)
gap3_truncation.note: Gap-3 statements are relative to this declared truncation family (constitution section 4)

rng_scheme.event_log: every draw logged as (step_id, stream_name, stream_counter); replay re-derives streams from master seed + log

emitted_per_phase: offline_compute_units (parameter-update passes x data size touched)
cost_metering_fields.note: N0 is candidate-free; fields are emitted-but-unused here so downstream N1 inherits the accounting schema (card R1 item 6; offline-compute parity per constitution section 5)

battery_membership.deletion_forbidden: removing a member after it fails to lose is a fatal invalidator (constitution section 11)
battery_membership.graph_cache_note: graph-cache family implemented as real fitted tables with alias_report each (rung3 precedent; card mandatory)

PC_LEAK_PLANT.config: mutated copy with theta planted in an observation field

NULL_env_control.config: theta decoupled from obs and probes
NULL_env_control.required: NO system shows headroom beyond MDE, else FAIL_NULL_FALSE_HEADROOM

positive_controls.failure_rule: any PC failure => invalid_integrity regardless of other numbers (card section Acceptance gate)
